Exploring local attractions, such as Pier Park and Shipwreck Island Waterpark, is a breeze from our hotel on Panama Beach, with all the best shops, restaurants, and sights just 10-15 minutes away, often even less. items.description: The Emerald Coast of Florida is named for the Gulf’s beautiful green-blue waters, and Panama City Beach is its crown jewel. Situated right along the town’s sugary sands lies a hidden gem: our Panama City Beach Resort. Here, it’s easy to spend all your vacation time beachside. After all, you’re just steps away. But if you do step off the pillow-soft sand and want to switch things up, our beach resort also has an outdoor pool, hot tub, activity center, barbecue grill, fire pit and fitness center. Plus, there’s tons of things to do in Panama City Beach itself. Take a short walk or drive over to Pier Park, one of the best Panama City Beach attractions with shopping, dining and entertainment for all ages. Check out experiences like Ripley’s® Panama City Beach and WonderWorks. To add a “little” something special, swim with the dolphins at Water Planet. For even more activities to fill your days in the Florida Panhandle, go fish! The Gulf is known for its prized game fish, and top charters will help you get that big red snapper you’ve been wanting to catch. Panama City Beach Resort is your beachy home away from home with picture-perfect waterfront views from every villa. Our beach resort offers spacious one- and two-bedroom villas from 708 to 968 square feet, each complete with living room space, a full-sized kitchen and in-unit washer and dryer. Please note there is a resort fee that includes a variety of onsite amenities.

Miller County Pier and the pristine shores of Shell Island Beach. Visit art galleries and antique stores downtown, shop and dine at Pier Park, discover boutiques on the bay at Historic St. Andrews, and boat or snorkel at St. Andrews Park. Plus, we're just a five-minute drive from Sacred Heart Bay Medical and Gulf Coast Hospital. Relax with a dip in our heated indoor pool and hot tub and stay active in our Fitness Center. Enjoy delicious meals at Bellini Café & Cocktail Lounge, where kids under 12 eat free or grab a snack from our 24/7 market. Host events in our venues, co-work or socialize in our open-concept lounge, and take advantage of free parking and free Wi-Fi. No matter what brings you to Panama City, we ensure your stay will be unforgettable!
